name: OpenMontage
description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.
one_liner: Turns your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio that scripts, edits, and renders finished videos from a text description.
buyer: A solo content creator or small e-commerce brand who needs to publish short videos daily without hiring an editor.
business_use_cases: A solo creator turns a blog post into a narrated, edited short-form video for social media in minutes.
An e-commerce brand generates a new product ad video every week without a video team.
A course creator batch-produces lesson videos from written scripts.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'done-for-you weekly video' subscription service built on top of this pipeline for small brands.
Sell one-off produced videos per project for creators who don't want to run the tool themselves.

steal_this: Launch a $99/video 'AI video editor for hire' gig this weekend using this pipeline to serve small e-commerce sellers.
